page.overview:
Who is Ambulanceman?

The Ambulanceman was a henchman working for Hugo Drax who attempted to kidnap James Bond in the 1979 film Moonraker. He was portrayed by French actor Guy Di Rigo.

Following an encounter with Jaws and Samuel, henchmen of the nefarious Hugo Drax, in Rio de Janeiro, Bond and Dr. Holly Goodhead were captured by this henchman and another individual also in Drax's employ, who were impersonating paramedics. The two goons quickly knocked out Bond and Goodhead, abducting them aboard their 'ambulance' and binding them both to stretchers.

Onboard, this henchman was assigned to guard the pair. Though he at first maintained a stoic disposition, Goodhead's charming smile lowered his guard long enough for Bond to escape from his bindings. A scuffle occurred, culminating in both this henchman and Bond tumbling out of the ambulance on the latter's wheeled stretcher. While Bond fell off it and onto the street, the ambulanceman sailed down the road and landed head-first in a British Airways billboard, comically sticking from the oversized mouth of the woman depicted on it.

His fate after this incident is unknown. He is not seen to move in the moments after hitting the sign, and it is likely that he died as a result of impacting headfirst into the billboard. If not , he was likely incarcerated following Drax's death.
